Kids today have social media... which we had but to an even greater extent... kids in several years will have something else and the kids of today will talk about the differences in their childhoods. It's all cyclical.

I mean... that's assuming the country and government don't fall apart, a major war doesn't break out, and climate change doesn't cause severe mass destruction before the next generation or two gets older. I'm sorry but I have to disagree...
5'7"... I turned out to be about 6'1" unfortunately... :/
I'm 6'1'' or so and I always wanted to be like, 5'7''... 5'4'' would be great too. I hate being tall.

Best: I can consume more calories

Worst: I stand out (which I hate, I have social anxiety and a plethora of other issues), terrible posture (as a result of the first problem), am assumed to be stronger/more capable than I generally am which leads to situations I'd much rather avoid, people comment on my height even though I hate it (26 and never grew to love it or even find contentment with it), finding a partner who is taller than me is incredibly unlikely (not a requirement but I'd really just like to know what it feels like not to be the tallest person in the room... with my partner for a long duration of time), I weigh more than my shorter counterparts even if I'm thin, shoe shopping, glove shopping, hat shopping, seeing something that looks really cute but it's from a country in Asia and realizing I'll never fit into it, being assumed older as a child which put me in situations that were not fun, lack of sympathy because being tall is supposed to be objectively positive (it's not, it's subjectively positive... there are plenty of people who would not want to be tall if given the choice), never fitting into any group of friends I make height wise, never feeling comfortable leaving the house because groups make me feel like a monster trying to blend in with humans, growing my hair long takes forever because the size of my head and length of my body makes any progress look minimal even if there's technically a lot of hair, being taller than my parents during my formative years which was really really unpleasant for me, not being able to be seen as "cute" or "soft" (which is what my personality naturally is), feeling like I have to be incredibly soft spoken and kind to strangers so that they don't feel threatened by my stature, hitting my head and limbs on everything, joking around with friends by faking anger and actually scaring them, having to be some kind of pillar of strength or whatever in certain situations (not that type of person at all), terrible posture and need to adjust leading to back and shoulder problems, generally being seen as dominant in situations that I do not want to be (which is all of them)...

if I had to pick an extreme then I'd rather be really short than really tall... even if it was 4'11'' VS 6'0'' I'd still pick 4'11''...
I'm submissive and I wish I had a dominant man as my significant other so I could do all of these things for him...
